title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28

ai_review.summary: Crisp but slightly bass‑thin soundboard recording of a gem show with standout versions of Playin’ China/Rider and Eyes.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the set as a “gem,” highlighting especially strong renditions of Playin' China/Rider and Eyes. The soundboard capture is described as crisp, though it suffers from a thin low end, wind noise and an occasional whine on He’s Gone > Truckin’, meaning the recording is good but not flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and praise the musical performance, while noting only modest technical shortcomings (bass loss, wind noise, whine). The balance of an excellent show with a generally solid recording yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp overall but noticeably bass‑thin; needs EQ. Wind noise present and a whine on the He’s Gone > Truckin' transition.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as a gem with strong, flowing performances; no specific pacing issues noted.
